**Quick answer:** Playa Sur is the quieter coastal district with lower prices and longer lets on the island.

## Prices

Median asking price per sqm in 2026 is 1,900 CRC, based on the registry's first half figures.

## Who lives here

Retired couples on annual leases and island families who work in the port.
